metadata.title: Riedel-Kruse, Müller, Oates & Jülicher (2007) Science / Morelli et al. (2009) HFSP J. — Delayed Kuramoto Phase-Oscillator Lattice, Collective Frequency Shift & DAPT Initiation/Failure/Rescue Synchrony Dynamics in the Zebrafish Segmentation Clock

sources.citation: Riedel-Kruse IH, Müller C, Oates AC (2007). Synchrony dynamics during initiation, failure, and rescue of the segmentation clock. Science 317(5846):1911-1915.
Morelli LG, Ares S, Herrgen L, Schröter C, Jülicher F, Oates AC (2009). Delayed coupling theory of vertebrate segmentation. HFSP Journal 3(1):55-66.
Herrgen L, Ares S, Morelli LG, Schröter C, Jülicher F, Oates AC (2010). Intercellular coupling regulates the period of the segmentation clock. Current Biology 20(14):1244-1253.
Horikawa K, Ishimatsu K, Yoshimoto E, Kondo S, Takeda H (2006). Noise-resistant and synchronized oscillation of the segmentation clock. Nature 441(7094):719-723.

zebrafish_psm_synchrony_specimen.species: Danio rerio / Vertebrate embryo dorsal scanning electron micrograph showing central neural tube, presomitic mesoderm, and bilateral segmented somite metameres

riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.section: Riedel-Kruse et al. (2007) Science 317:1911-1915 Eq. 1 & SOM; Morelli et al. (2009) HFSP J. 3:55-66 Eqs. 1-5
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.delayed_kuramoto_lattice_sde: dtheta_i(t)/dt = omega_0 + (kappa / z) * sum_{j in N(i)} sin(theta_j(t - tau_c) - theta_i(t)) + xi_i(t)
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.collective_frequency_shift_law: Omega = omega_0 - kappa * sin(Omega * tau_c),  T_sync = 2 * pi / Omega
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.linear_stability_criterion: kappa_eff = kappa * cos(Omega * tau_c) > 0  (stable in-phase synchrony for cos(Omega * tau_c) > 0; anti-phase instability for cos(Omega * tau_c) < 0)
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.ald_anterior_limit_of_defects_law: ALD(s_in) = s_in + Delta_n_ALD,  where Delta_n_ALD = ln(R_SS / R_crit) / (D_phi * T_0) + Delta_n_det ~ 5.5 somites
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.prp_posterior_rescue_point_law: PRP(s_out) = s_out + Delta_n_PRP,  where Delta_n_PRP ~ 5.5 somites after DAPT washout at stage s_out

canonical_zebrafish_psm_parameters.species: Danio rerio (zebrafish presomitic mesoderm at 28 C)

riedel_kruse_2007_dapt_perturbation_regi.source: Riedel-Kruse, Müller & Oates (2007) Science 317:1911-1915 Figs. 1-4; Morelli et al. (2009) HFSP J. 3:55-66; Herrgen et al. (2010) Current Biology 20:1244-1253

regimes.label: Wild-type DMSO control (continuous DeltaC-Notch coupling kappa = 0.070 min^-1, tau_c = 20.5 min)
Continuous DAPT Notch blockade at gastrulation (s_in = 0 somite stage; mimics bea/des/aei/mib)
Continuous DAPT Notch blockade added at 4-somite stage (s_in = 4)
Continuous DAPT Notch blockade added at 9-somite stage (s_in = 9)
DAPT pulse-chase rescue (DAPT in at s_in = 0, washed out at s_out = 9 -> ALD = 5.5, PRP = 14.5)
